title: bug: VS Code keeps a pending plan approval through a non-AA, non-WORKING frame, so a later WORKING at the same revision reports 'Plan approved'; JetBrains latches
description:
Repro, as scratch corpus rows that fail only in VS Code (CQ-I06b round 2): render AA rev 4, click Approve, push PLANNING rev 4 then WORKING rev 4. That is row A26 = latched; A27, PLANNING 4 alone, is also latched. JetBrains PlanReviewApprovalState goes PENDING -> INVALIDATED (STATUS_CHANGED) on the PLANNING frame. VS Code PlanReviewPanel.settlePendingApproval acts only on WORKING or a vanished task, so pendingApprovalRevision survives and the WORKING 4 announces success.
Fix: clear the pending approval when the task is present but neither AWAITING_APPROVAL nor WORKING (about 2 lines), and add A26/A27 to moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-verdicts.json. Both clients' corpus runners already consume those rows.
definitionOfDone: Corpus rows A26 (PLANNING 4, then WORKING 4) and A27 (PLANNING 4), both latched, pass in both clients' corpus runners.
VS Code PlanReviewPanel ends a pending approval unconfirmed when the task is present but neither AWAITING_APPROVAL nor WORKING. Existing plan-review sections stay green.
Fresh `cd moe-vscode && npm test && npm run compile` plus the JetBrains `./gradlew test` (or its labelled Windows equivalent) exit 0.

implementationPlan.description:
RED: add the two corpus rows from the task, then watch them fail only in VS Code.

In moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-verdicts.json the approval array has one row per line. A25 is the last row (line 27, no trailing comma), followed by `],` and `"vm":[`. Give A25 a trailing comma and append exactly these two lines after it, the last one without a comma:
{"id":"A26","rendered":"4","events":[{"task":{"status":"PLANNING","planRevision":"4"}},{"task":{"status":"WORKING","planRevision":"4"}}],"verdict":"latched"},
{"id":"A27","rendered":"4","events":[{"task":{"status":"PLANNING","planRevision":"4"}}],"verdict":"latched"}
Keep LF endings and touch no other byte. That includes the vm rows, `version` and `taskId`. Both runners pick the rows up with no runner change: VS Code moe-vscode/tests/plan-review.test.cjs section L (`for (const row of CORPUS.approval)`), and JetBrains ClientVerdictCorpusTest (it requires ids matching A[0-9]{2}, unique, at least 25 rows).

Run `cd moe-vscode && npm test`. Expect exactly two failures:
- `L A26: latched` fails on the first latched assertion: its WORKING 4 event goes through settlePendingApproval and shows 'Plan approved'.
- `L A27: latched` fails at 'a WORKING probe at the rendered revision must not confirm'.
Every other test stays green. If anything else fails, or A26/A27 pass, stop and investigate before step 2. Record the RED output for the completion summary.

JetBrains needs no production change. PlanReviewApprovalState.onStateUpdate sends PENDING plus a present PLANNING snapshot through unusableReason to INVALIDATED (STATUS_CHANGED_KEY), and INVALIDATED ignores every later frame. Both rows already latch there; step 3 proves it.
implementationPlan.note: RED: npm test 239 tests, 237 pass, 2 fail: L A26 and L A27 (Plan approved announced). Other 805 dirty paths belong to others; untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
GREEN: end the pending approval unconfirmed on any present, non-AWAITING_APPROVAL, non-WORKING status in moe-vscode/src/panels/PlanReviewPanel.ts settlePendingApproval (around lines 147-175).

Replace the single line `if (task.status !== 'WORKING') { return; }` with two branches:
- `if (task.status === 'AWAITING_APPROVAL') { return; }`: still waiting on the daemon. Rows A13 (pending) and A14 (latched via the error) depend on this staying exactly as it is.
- `if (task.status !== 'WORKING') { this.pendingApprovalRevision = undefined; return; }`: covers PLANNING, BLOCKED, REVIEW, DONE, ARCHIVED, BACKLOG and any unknown status. Give it a one-line comment in the style of the vanished-task line above it, e.g. `// Leaving AWAITING_APPROVAL for anything but WORKING ends it unconfirmed too (JetBrains STATUS_CHANGED parity).`
Also extend the method's doc comment by one sentence: a present task that leaves AWAITING_APPROVAL for any status other than WORKING ends the approval unconfirmed, the same as a vanished task.

Design choices, so nobody re-derives them:
- Do NOT call reportApprovalFailure or post approveFailed here. The debounced updateTask already latches the page: planReview.js tokenForTask returns null for a non-AA task, so applyRenderedTask latches with NOT_APPROVABLE_NOTICE, the JetBrains statusChanged notice equivalent. That is also what the vanished-task branch does: clear the token only. With stale:true the page would show the wrong notice (PLAN_CHANGED). With stale:false a transient text would flash before the updateTask latch.
- No toast. Toasts stay reserved for the confirmed, mismatch and connection-loss paths.
- Do not touch media/planReview.js, plan-review.test.cjs, any Kotlin, or the daemon. The webview UI is unchanged: it latched on that frame before the fix too. Only the extension-side token stops surviving, so a later WORKING at the same revision no longer announces 'Plan approved'.
The error handling paths are unchanged. handleClientError still reports a correlated APPROVE_TASK refusal. handleConnectionChange now returns early after a status-change clear (pending is undefined), which is correct because the page is already latched. No new IO, so no new failure path.

Re-run `cd moe-vscode && npm test`: all green, including L A26 and L A27. Then run `npm run compile` (tsc) and expect exit 0.
implementationPlan.note: GREEN: settlePendingApproval clears pendingApprovalRevision on a present non-AA non-WORKING task. npm test 239/239 (WSL). compile: WSL `npm run compile` fails only on missing @typescript/typescript-linux-x64 (win32 node_modules); tsc6 exit 0 in WSL and `cmd.exe npm run compile` exit 0.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review of this task's own diff. Load adversarial-self-review. Check:
(a) Back-to-back frames inside one render debounce: settlePendingApproval runs per state event before the debounce, so a PLANNING frame clears the token before a following WORKING frame. The page may render only the last frame, and it still latches.
(b) AWAITING_APPROVAL frames at the same or another revision still keep the approval pending. A13 stays pending and A14 stays latched via its PLAN_REVISION_MISMATCH error.
(c) The vanished-task branch and the WORKING match/mismatch branches are byte-for-byte unchanged. A01-A12 and A23-A25 still pass.
(d) An APPROVE_TASK error arriving after the clear only re-posts approveFailed to an already latched page, which never re-arms. A connection drop after the clear stays silent.
(e) The diff is exactly the two files: corpus +2 rows and a comma; panel about +3/-1 plus the doc sentence. JSON parses, the ids are unique, LF is kept, no forbidden patterns, no edits under .moe/.
(f) Both clients agree on all 27 approval rows.
Fix anything found, re-run the step 3 commands if any byte changed, then complete_task with the step 3 evidence and the step 1 RED output.
implementationPlan.note: Self-review (a)-(f): AA frames still return early (A13/A14 green); vanished and WORKING branches byte-unchanged; diff is exactly 2 files (panel +5/-1, corpus +3/-1, LF, JSON parses, ids unique); no .moe edits; both clients pass 27 approval rows. No bytes changed after the step 3 gate.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: 1) Chosen: clear pendingApprovalRevision in settlePendingApproval on a present task that is neither AWAITING_APPROVAL nor WORKING. It mirrors JetBrains PENDING -> INVALIDATED (STATUS_CHANGED_KEY) and the existing vanished-task branch. 2) Rejected: also post approveFailed or show a toast. The page already latches on the debounced non-AA updateTask (NOT_APPROVABLE_NOTICE), stale:true would show the wrong PLAN_CHANGED text, and stale:false would flash a transient notice. 3) Rejected: changing the webview or the corpus runners. Both runners already consume new approval rows, and the page latch from task-f2d3d553 is correct.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: settlePendingApproval runs on every client state event before the render debounce (PlanReviewPanel.ts ~100). The webview owns the visible latch: planReview.js tokenForTask returns null when status != AWAITING_APPROVAL, and applyRenderedTask then latches. JetBrains PlanReviewApprovalState.onStateUpdate leaves READY/PENDING only for FINISHED (WORKING at the captured revision) or INVALIDATED (unusableReason/staleReason). INVALIDATED ignores later frames. The corpus format is one row per line and the last approval row has no trailing comma. The ClientVerdictCorpusTest gate needs ids A[0-9]{2}, unique, at least 25 rows.
